settings.title: Fit & sizing
settings.body: Boxy through the body with a set shoulder. True to size for a relaxed fit; size down for a closer one.

settings.title: Fabric & care
settings.body: Cold wash, inside out, like colours. Tumble low or hang. No softener, which coats heavyweight cotton and stops it breathing.

settings.title: Shipping & returns
settings.body: Picked the same day and dispatched within 48 hours. Free shipping over $125. Thirty days to change your mind, unworn with tags on.
